risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively supported, including segment margins, liquidity, debt, capital spending, and one-time items. Risk exposure is concentrated in inflation, labor availability, supply-chain disruption, interest rates, geopolitical conflict, COVID-19 uncertainty, and weaker performance in Beef, Pork, and Prepared Foods. The tone is balanced but modestly cautious due to ongoing cost pressures and forward-looking uncertainties.
